title: Reduce console chat startup latency and improve timing observability

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Implementing two-phase console latency reduction: disable DSPy disk cache for responder, reduce history defaults with token budget guard, add latency decomposition fields, and cache warm-path client/runtime init with focused tests.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Implemented latency mitigation/observability patch: DSPy disk cache env disable in Console responder stack; runtime history defaults 6/160 plus token-budget retention (2200 default, newest-first); latency payload now includes pre_model_ms, model_first_chunk_ms, model_stream_ms, post_model_persist_ms and startup-phase timestamps; responder now caches GraphQL client across warm invocations and warms procedure service cache once. Tests passed: pytest -q plexus/console/test_chat_runtime.py dashboard/amplify/functions/consoleRunWorker/app_test.py and pytest -q dashboard/amplify/functions/consoleRunWorker
